texts.preamble: Smt. Deva Adi Venkata Lakshmi ... vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh, on 12 September, 2019 Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao Criminal Petition No.4959 Of 2019 Order:
texts.facts: 1. The petitioners/accused Nos.2 to 5 seek to quash the proceedings against them in C.C. No.240 of 2018, pending on the file of learned Additional Judicial First Class Magistrate, Addanki, Prakasam district (for short, 'the trial Court'), which was taken cognizance for the offences under Sections 188 and 273 of IPC and Sections 58, 59 and 63 of Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006 (for short, 'the FSS Act'). 2. The allegations against the petitioners briefly are that, on 30.01.2018 at 16.450 hours, on receiving the credible information, the complainant suo motu registered the case against accused Nos.1 to 5 on the ground that A-1 and A-2 are in possession of the banned tobacco products, being supplied by A-3 to A-5, for selling the same to innocent public at a higher price deteriorating their health condition and on interrogation as the accused voluntarily confessed to have been engaged in the business of prohibited tobacco products, seized the same and registered F.I.R. for the offences stated supra. 3. Learned counsel for petitioners while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the definition of Section 3(j) of FSS Act and therefore the police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet and therefore registration of the FIR and filing charge sheet is contrary to the provisions of FSS Act.
